instruction: Candid black and white documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. On an outdoor paved walkway under an overcast sky, the woman in the black coat and cap (R2) and the bearded man in the grey overcoat (R1) walk closely side-by-side. The woman (R2) is on the left, smiling warmly as she looks ahead. The bearded man (R1) is on the right, shown in profile as he walks forward. They are holding hands gently at waist height. The shot features a monochrome palette with soft, diffused daylight and a clean, uncluttered background.
